clue.text: Force some apples into kitchen equipment

parts.note: pressure is force applied, as in putting pressure on someone
cookers are apples grown for cooking rather than eating raw

explanation.surface: Someone is cramming a batch of apples into a kitchen gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressure cookers are sealed pans found among the appliances and utensils of a kitchen.

clue.text: Energetic law breaker?

parts.note: a machine running forever without input would break the laws of thermodynamics, the laws of energy

explanation.surface: A lively criminal on the run.
explanation.definitionFit: Endless self-sustaining motion would violate conservation of energy, so it breaks physical law.

clue.text: Once straight on death wish

parts.note: end is death, as in meeting one's end
to long is to wish or yearn

explanation.surface: Someone who once headed straight for a death wish.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning lengthwise or straight ahead, hence 'once'.

clue.text: Hearing looks about oil producer's marine protection facilities

indicators.note: about means the heard word goes round the company name
hearing says the word for looks is taken by its sound

parts.note: sees means looks
Shell is a major oil company

explanation.surface: An inquiry into an oil company's offshore safety installations.
explanation.definitionFit: A seashell is the hard casing a mollusc lives in for protection at sea.

clue.text: Survival of software licence

indicators.note: of signals the letters come out of the words that follow, across the gap

explanation.surface: A legacy piece of software licensing that has outlived its use.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is something that survives from an earlier time.

clue.text: Mountebank left a function after tea

indicators.note: after puts the left, a and function pieces after the tea word

parts.note: char is British slang for tea
tan, tangent, is a trigonometric function

explanation.surface: A trickster departs a party once tea is served.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountebank is a swindler or quack, a fraud.

clue.text: Removes judge from trials

indicators.note: from says the judge letter is taken out of the trials word

parts.note: jousts are contests or trials of skill

explanation.surface: A judge is taken off a series of court hearings.
explanation.definitionFit: To oust is to expel or eject, so it means removes.

clue.text: Ancient embraces earth goddess with both hands

indicators.note: embraces means the ancient word wraps round the goddess

parts.note: early means ancient, from long ago
Ge, or Gaia, is the Greek earth goddess

explanation.surface: An old figure holds the earth goddess tight in both arms.
explanation.definitionFit: To grab something with both hands is an idiom for seizing it keenly.

clue.text: Dizzy price mummies regularly expended for beachwear

parts.note: one's head swimming means feeling dizzy
cost means price

indicators.note: every other letter is spent, removed, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Mothers spending a dizzying sum on seaside clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bathing suit is the garment worn for the beach.

clue.text: American hawk trailed badly

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so the letters of the word before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: A hawk that lagged behind its flock, poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: The red-tail is a common North American buzzard, a bird of prey of the hawk family.

clue.text: Bottom and top around, say, spear

parts.note: ass is American slang for the backside
eg, for example, is the abbreviation that 'say' stands for
A1 (written AI) means first-rate, top quality

explanation.surface: A list of body parts and headgear, then 'say, spear', as though offering one more example.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a slender iron-tipped spear used by southern African peoples.

clue.text: Time to return from North Copenhagen

indicators.note: return says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Instructions for when to travel back from the northern part of the Danish capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters HCOPE sit inside 'North Copenhagen', and 'return' reads them backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is an era or period, a span of history.

clue.text: Company condemned unusual component of mother's milk

parts.note: a lost soul is one condemned or damned
rum is British slang for odd or strange

explanation.surface: A firm denounced for some odd ingredient found in breast milk.
explanation.definitionFit: Colostrum is the first, antibody-rich secretion a mammal produces after giving birth, before true milk.

clue.text: Bitterness in a continental soldier is caddish

indicators.note: in places the bitterness word within the other two pieces

parts.note: un is the French for 'a'
a soldier ant is a worker caste of ant
gall is bitterness or rancour

explanation.surface: A resentful European infantryman behaves like a cad.
explanation.definitionFit: Being impolite to women, lacking chivalry, is what a cad does.

clue.text: Spy arresting Republican in a South American country

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so the spy word holds the party letter

parts.note: an agent is a spy

explanation.surface: An agent detains a Republican in Latin America.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina is a nation of South America.

clue.text: Acquire telephone next to pub

indicators.note: as a verb, telephone hints at a voice heard over the line, so we go by sound

parts.note: by an inn: by means next to, an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: Getting a phone installed near the local.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay in a stock is to purchase supplies, so the phrasal verb means obtain.

clue.text: One may be pushed to involve Henry in group song

indicators.note: in places the Henry letter inside the group word

parts.note: a batch is a group or set
H is the symbol of the henry, the unit of inductance
an air is a song or tune

explanation.surface: Someone is coaxed into getting Henry to join a sing-along.
explanation.walkthrough: A bath chair is an old hooded wheelchair, once used by invalids at the spa town of Bath.
explanation.definitionFit: An invalid's wheeled chair, pushed by an attendant, is something that gets pushed.

clue.text: Runs electrical distributors

definitions.meaning: manages or heads, as one runs a team
flexes or cables carrying current to appliances

explanation.surface: Runs electrical distributors: someone manages power suppliers.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading something and the wires that carry power are both senses of the word.

clue.text: Initially attend chief

parts.note: to attend an event is to be at it
first means chief or foremost

explanation.surface: First of all, look after the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean in the beginning, at the outset.

clue.text: General set of books has unknown picture of a representative group

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books of the Bible
y is an algebraic unknown
pic is short for picture

explanation.surface: A general's bookshelf holds a mystery photo of a sample group.
explanation.definitionFit: A genotype is also the type species of a genus, its representative, so the adjective describes that.

clue.text: Procession with European team in ancient city

parts.note: pomp is ceremonial display, a stately procession
a team of eleven, written XI or II in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A parade with a European side through an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: Pompeii was a Roman city buried by Vesuvius in AD 79.

clue.text: Medicinal name accepted by bureaucrat?

indicators.note: accepted by means taken inside the bureaucrat word

parts.note: an official is a public functionary, a bureaucrat

explanation.surface: A drug's title approved by a pen-pusher.
explanation.definitionFit: Officinal plants and drugs are those used in medicine and kept in stock by pharmacists.

clue.text: About to duplicate doctrine

parts.note: c, circa, means about
to redo something is to do it again, to duplicate it

explanation.surface: Getting ready to copy out a set of beliefs.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a creed, a statement of belief.

clue.text: Report of rocket fuel in Scottish waters

indicators.note: report suggests something spoken, so the fuel word is taken by its sound

parts.note: lox is liquid oxygen, used to fuel rockets

explanation.surface: News of rocket fuel turning up in Scottish lakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lakes in Scotland are called lochs.

clue.text: Rascal moving south-east to find temporary lodgings

indicators.note: the letter for south travels east, rightwards to the far end of this across word

parts.note: a scamp is a mischievous rascal

explanation.surface: A rogue heads south-east looking for somewhere to stay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'south-east' is not SE: S is the piece and 'east' says where it goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Camps are sites of tents or huts for short stays.

clue.text: National airline's folded after new leader quits

indicators.note: folded suggests a business collapsing, signalling that the remaining letters are rearranged
quits says that first letter leaves the word before it
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A national carrier has gone bust once its new boss walked out.
explanation.walkthrough: AIRLINES less N gives AIRLIES, which 'folded' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A national of Israel is a citizen of that country.

clue.text: Talk with each superior wine producer

parts.note: chat means talk
U means upper-class, superior, in British usage

explanation.surface: A chat with every top vintner.
explanation.definitionFit: In Bordeaux a château is a wine estate, so it makes wine.

clue.text: Draft enthronement ceremony?

definitions.meaning: whimsically, a church service held for the whole nation at a coronation

explanation.surface: Draft enthronement ceremony: a provisional order of service for a coronation.
explanation.walkthrough: National service was British peacetime conscription until 1960.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscription is the American 'draft'; the second reading is a playful literal one.
